installedSdkCheck: Installed @octokit/app 16.1.4 constructs its app client from options.Octokit || OctokitCore; installed @octokit/core constructs token authentication when passed {auth: token} without authStrategy. Thus app.octokit.constructor used by scopedInstallation is the token-auth OctokitCore in this installation. This is a source inspection, not a network call or live SDK acceptance.
